correctness.rationale: Graph-state entropy equals GF(2) cross adjacency rank. Over F2[x,y]/(x^L−1,y^L−1), M is multiplication by 1+x+y and Q=coker M has dimension L−1 by roots α∈F_{2^k}\{0,1}. Two different monomials in Q cannot agree: α↦1+α forces u=v mod L; α↦1/α then forces L|3u; a polynomial of degree 2L/3<L−1 excludes the remaining nonzero case for L≥7. This is also true for transposed M. Distinct deleted row/column unit vectors are independent in the two cokernels, forcing ker(M+UVᵀ)=ker M∩ker Vᵀ and exact rank increase r≤2. Full independent GF2 rank enumeration of all 10,437 legal pairs at L=7 agrees, without extrapolating to all k.
